{"path": "todo_openrouter-moonshotai-kimi-k3_01.html", "edit_description": "Create a new single self-contained HTML file implementing a complete Todo app. All CSS in a <style> tag and all JS in a <script> tag in the same file, no external dependencies.

Features required:
1. Add new todos: input field + Add button, also submit on Enter key. Ignore empty/whitespace-only input.
2. Mark todos as complete: clicking a checkbox (or the todo text) toggles completion; completed todos show strikethrough text-decoration and dimmed color.
3. Delete todos: each todo item has a delete (×) button that removes it.
4. Filters: All / Active / Completed buttons (or tabs) that filter the visible list; active filter button visually highlighted.
5. Persist to localStorage: save the todos array (id, text, completed) under a key like 'todos' on every change; load and render on page load.

Also include: an items-left counter (e.g. "3 items left"), a "Clear completed" button, and an empty-state message when no todos match the current filter.

Design: clean modern look, centered card layout, sans-serif system font, subtle shadows, responsive, hover states on buttons. Use vanilla JS with a render() function that re-renders the list from state. Escape user text safely (use textContent / createElement, not innerHTML with user data)."}
